theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_sobolev_indicator
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (U G : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet G volume → IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν → ∀ (ζ : Rn (n + 1) → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ζ y) → eLpNorm (G.indicator ζ) ((n + 1 : ℝ≥0∞) / n) volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (∫ y, ζ y ∂μ + ∫ y in G, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ y‖))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
